description: Virtual Machine Contributor / run-command rights - execute code on an Azure VM as SYSTEM/root.

telemetry.detail: Azure Activity log: Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommand/action (Run Command on VM) (default-on).
If the VM is onboarded to Defender for Endpoint, the executed payload is caught on-host.
Microsoft Defender for Cloud (Defender for Servers/Resource Manager) can alert on anomalous Run Command / VM compute abuse; requires the paid plan + an onboarded resource.

prerequisite_privilege: Virtual Machine Contributor (or Owner/Contributor) on the VM
abuse_primitive: az vm run-command invoke to run a script as SYSTEM; or read the VM's managed-identity token.
notes: Run-command writes to the Azure Activity log and, if the VM has EDR, is loud on-host.
